posts.en:
dsh-custom-brand is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Customizable brand area for the Web UI: replace the whale logo and DeepSeek wordmark with local images, and edit the HARNESS badge text (double-click to change, right-click to reset).

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-16c85d71b63a84d8196c.html
